{"candidate": {"code": "def assign_partition(self, key: str, num_partitions: int | None = None) -> int:
    """Return the partition ID for *key*.

    BUG_58: uses ``hash(key) % (num_partitions + 1)`` which can
    return ``num_partitions`` itself -- an out-of-range value
    (valid range is ``0 .. num_partitions - 1``).  The fix must
    use ``hash(key) % num_partitions`` instead.
    """
    import orgops.health
    n = num_partitions if num_partitions is not None else self._config.num_partitions
    partition_id = _stable_hash(key) % n
    orgops.health.report_degradation("cache.partition.skew", partition_id)
    return partition_id", "comments": "Fix off-by-one modulus bug (use % n instead of % (n+1)) and add cache.partition.skew degradation reporting per guiding principle."}, "constraints": [{"id": "bug58_modulus_and_health", "voltsnip_key": "voltsnip/script30/hard/bug58/scenario_context/v1", "check": "Correct modulus AND health degradation report via orgops.health.report_degradation.", "judge_prompt": "Does the implementation both fix the modulus to hash(key) % num_partitions (removing the +1) AND report a cache.partition.skew degradation signal via orgops.health.report_degradation()?"}]}
